systems.system: Electronic payment of traffic fines by payment terminal (TPE)
systems.platform: electronic payment terminals taking bank cards and the Edahabia card
systems.owner: Ministry of Finance (Treasury), DGSN and Gendarmerie nationale, under a convention signed 24 May 2025
systems.tiers: police and gendarmerie agents nationwide after a trial in several wilayas; 2,000 terminals distributed to the security services at first

note: The only system is card payment of traffic fines to police and gendarmerie agents, a single-function system; nothing on how stations record reports or cases.
